headline: VNM cong bo loi nhuan quy 2 tang truong
body_excerpt: Loi nhuan sau thue quy 2 tang 12% so voi cung ky, vuot ky vong cua gioi phan tich.

headline: HPG thong bao chia co tuc bang tien mat
body_excerpt: Hoi dong quan tri thong qua phuong an chia co tuc tien mat ty le 10%.

headline: VCB bi yeu cau rieng soat quy trinh cho vay
body_excerpt: Co quan quan ly yeu cau VCB bao cao lai mot so quy trinh cho vay noi bo.

headline: FPT bo nhiem tong giam doc moi
body_excerpt: Hoi dong quan tri FPT thong qua quyet dinh bo nhiem tong giam doc moi ke tu thang sau.

headline: Ngan hang Nha nuoc dieu chinh lai suat dieu hanh
body_excerpt: Lai suat dieu hanh duoc dieu chinh giam 0.25 diem phan tram, tac dong tich cuc len tam ly thi truong chung.
